details: Bitcoin's price has fallen significantly, dropping below $62,000 and even reaching $60,000, which led to a massive $1.76 billion in liquidations across the broader crypto market within 24 hours. This downturn suggests a decreased probability of Bitcoin reaching higher price thresholds in the near term.
title: Bitcoin Price Plunges, Triggers $1.7 Billion in Liquidations

details: Ethereum (ETH) has dropped below the $1,800 mark, trading around $1,799 USDT, marking a 2.83% decrease in 24 hours. Analyst Ali Martinez noted that ETH dropped below a critical support level of $1,825, and failure to rebound could lead to a further decline towards $1,500.
title: Ethereum Drops Below $1,800 Amid Market Pressure

details: Binance has announced it will cease support for its centralized NFT marketplace by July 3, 2026, directing users to migrate assets to self-custodial wallets. This move reflects a broader downturn in the NFT sector, with annual trading volumes collapsing significantly from 2022 highs.
title: Binance to Shut Down Centralized NFT Marketplace

details: Charles Schwab has introduced nearly 24/7 trading for select cryptocurrency futures, including Bitcoin futures with a $5 multiplier, through its thinkorswim platform. This marks Schwab's first 24/7 product and signals future plans for spot crypto trading, custody, and transfers for registered investment advisors by mid-2027.
title: Charles Schwab Launches 24/7 Cryptocurrency Futures Trading

details: Cardano's ADA token has fallen 6% in 24 hours to $0.20, reaching its lowest point in over five years. This decline has raised concerns about the sustainability of firms within the Cardano ecosystem, with founder Charles Hoskinson warning of potential shutdowns for numerous companies this year due to ongoing market pressures.
title: Cardano (ADA) Hits Five-Year Low
